principle: Professional training starts only after a region-aware knowledge base exists. For the first implementation profile, Russia is authoritative for legal/regulatory applicability; technical choices then proceed from standards to languages to scientifically supported algorithms and engineering decisions.

region_model.rule: Every professional decision is evaluated under an explicit REGION_PROFILE. Region-specific law, mandatory standards, regulator requirements and sector overlays are resolved before technical preference rules.

mandatory_build_order.title: Россия: законы, применимость стандартов, ГОСТ и регуляторные overlays
mandatory_build_order.goal: Determine what is mandatory, conditional, voluntary, contractual, current, superseded or future-effective before recommending implementation choices.
required_inputs: current official texts and amendment chains
mandatory_build_order.gate: No Russian professional baseline may be declared complete while NECESSARY applicability/currentness gaps remain unresolved.

mandatory_build_order.title: ГОСТ/стандарты профессиональной деятельности программиста
mandatory_build_order.goal: Map standards to concrete developer work products and actions: requirements, design, code, documentation, testing, maintenance, secure development and evidence.

mandatory_build_order.title: Языки программирования и официальные правила их использования
mandatory_build_order.goal: Describe each language through primary specifications/documentation, supported paradigms, type/memory/concurrency model, ecosystem and operational constraints.
mandatory_build_order.rule: Community opinion cannot override a primary language specification or measured project evidence.

mandatory_build_order.title: Правила выбора и применения языка
mandatory_build_order.goal: Convert language knowledge into conditional decision rules instead of ranking languages globally.

mandatory_build_order.title: Алгоритмы и научно обоснованные критерии выбора
mandatory_build_order.goal: Represent algorithms by preconditions, correctness, computational complexity, memory complexity, data properties and empirical behavior.
mandatory_build_order.rule: An algorithm is selected from problem/data constraints; no algorithm is marked globally best.

mandatory_build_order.title: Компоновка решения
mandatory_build_order.goal: Compose standards, language choice, algorithm choice, data structures, security and testing into a traceable implementation decision.

mandatory_build_order.title: Только после KB: задачи и обучение
mandatory_build_order.goal: Every task must teach or verify explicit knowledge nodes and relations already present in PROGRAMMING_KB.
mandatory_build_order.gate: No new derived training corpus is promoted while PROGRAMMING_KB MIN gate is incomplete.

programming_kb_min_gate: RU normative applicability/currentness NECESSARY minimum is resolved or explicit GAPs are recorded
core programming standards are mapped to developer actions/work products
minimum language catalog exists with primary sources
core algorithm/data-structure catalog exists with complexity/precondition/scientific evidence
task-to-knowledge relations are representable and tested
no training artifact can bypass knowledge/source traceability
